replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using AI tools for math, but it was confusing. My low openness to new experiences meant I didn't stick with it, and my dislike for math made it hard to focus.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, identify the equation like ax² + bx + c = 0. Then, calculate the discriminant (b² – 4ac). If positive, use the quadratic formula (-b ± √(b² – 4ac)) / 2a. If zero, one solution; if negative, no real solutions.
